name: team-tmux
description: The team coordination protocol carried entirely over tmux, for fleets running where SendMessage does not exist (Bedrock, third-party providers). Same contract and the same skill names as `team` — pre-warm (ready), partition (plan-fleet), delegate (brief), report back (report), hand off at context limits (relay), plus the transport itself (send-tmux-message) — with every machine arrow hard-wired to the tmux transport. Enable this plugin or `team`, never both.
